API Details¶

A module for simple but important utility functions.

neurora.stuff.clusterbased_permutation_1d_1samp_1sided(results, level=0, p_threshold=0.05, clusterp_threshold=0.05, n_threshold=2, n_iter=1000, random_state=None, n_jobs=None)¶

One-sample one-sided cluster-based permutation test for 1-D results.

Parameters:

  • results (array_like, shape [n_subs, x]) – Subject-level results.

  • level (float, default=0) – Null-hypothesis level.

  • p_threshold (float, default=0.05) – Cluster-forming p-value threshold.

  • clusterp_threshold (float, default=0.05) – Cluster-level p-value threshold.

  • n_threshold (int, default=2) – Minimum cluster size.

  • n_iter (int, default=1000) – Number of permutations.

  • random_state (int or None, default=None) – Random seed.

  • n_jobs (int or None, default=None) – Number of parallel jobs for MNE.

Returns:

ps – Binary significance vector.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [x]

neurora.stuff.clusterbased_permutation_1d_1samp_2sided(results, level=0, p_threshold=0.05, clusterp_threshold=0.05, n_threshold=2, n_iter=1000, random_state=None, n_jobs=None)¶

One-sample two-sided cluster-based permutation test for 1-D results.

Returns:

ps – Signed significance vector.

  • 1 : significantly greater than level

  • -1 : significantly less than level

  • 0 : not significant

Return type:

ndarray, shape [x]

neurora.stuff.clusterbased_permutation_1d_1sided(results1, results2, p_threshold=0.05, clusterp_threshold=0.05, n_threshold=2, n_iter=1000, random_state=None, n_jobs=None)¶

Paired one-sided cluster-based permutation test for 1-D results.

Tests whether results1 > results2.

Paired two-sided cluster-based permutation test for 1-D results.

neurora.stuff.correct_by_threshold(img, threshold, connectivity=1)¶

Correct fMRI RSA results by removing clusters smaller than a voxel threshold.

Parameters:

  • img (array_like, shape [nx, ny, nz]) – A 3-D fMRI RSA result map.

  • threshold (int) –

    Minimum cluster size in voxels.

    Clusters with fewer than threshold non-zero voxels will be removed.

  • connectivity ({1, 2, 3}, default=1) – Cluster connectivity.

Returns:

corrected_img – Threshold-corrected image.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [nx, ny, nz]

neurora.stuff.datamask(fmri_data, mask_data)¶

Filter a 3-D fMRI map by a 3-D ROI mask.

Parameters:

  • fmri_data (array_like, shape [nx, ny, nz]) – fMRI data.

  • mask_data (array_like, shape [nx, ny, nz]) – ROI mask.

Returns:

newfmri_data – Masked fMRI data. Voxels outside the mask are NaN.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [nx, ny, nz]

neurora.stuff.fdr_correct(p, p_threshold)¶

FDR correction for fMRI RSA results using Benjamini-Hochberg correction.

Parameters:

  • p (array_like, shape [nx, ny, nz]) – A 3-D p-value map.

  • p_threshold (float) – FDR-corrected p-value threshold.

Returns:

fdrp – FDR-corrected p-value map.

Voxels whose corrected p-values do not survive p_threshold are NaN.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [nx, ny, nz]

neurora.stuff.fwe_correct(p, p_threshold)¶

FWE correction for fMRI RSA results using Bonferroni correction.

Parameters:

  • p (array_like, shape [nx, ny, nz]) – A 3-D p-value map.

  • p_threshold (float) – Corrected p-value threshold.

Returns:

fwep – FWE-corrected p-value map.

Voxels whose corrected p-values do not survive p_threshold are NaN.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [nx, ny, nz]

neurora.stuff.normalize_rdm(rdm, method='minmax', keep_diagonal=True)¶

Normalize a representational dissimilarity matrix (RDM).

Parameters:

  • rdm (array_like, shape [n_cons, n_cons] or [..., n_cons, n_cons]) –

    Input RDM or a stack of RDMs.

    The last two dimensions should be square matrices.

  • method ({"minmax", "zscore"}, default="minmax") –

    Normalization method.

    • ”minmax”: scale off-diagonal values to the range [0, 1]

    • ”zscore”: standardize off-diagonal values to mean 0 and standard deviation 1

  • keep_diagonal (bool, default=True) –

    Whether to keep the diagonal values unchanged.

    If True, diagonal values are copied from the original RDM. If False, diagonal values are set to 0.

Returns:

normalized_rdm – Normalized RDM with the same shape as the input.

Return type:

ndarray

Notes

Normalization is applied separately to each RDM when a stack of RDMs is provided.

Only off-diagonal values are used to estimate min/max or mean/std.
